distro-distro:lever:4cab253f-bde5-4e4f-b.title: Optician/Optometric Technician
distro-distro:lever:4cab253f-bde5-4e4f-b.description: Hidden Valley Eye Care is a growing family practice located in Draper, UT. We are seeking a full-time Optician to assist our doctor and work closely with patients. Pay rate is competitive and based on experience. The right candidate will have great customer service skills, pay attention to detail, and multi-task efficiently. Duties include, but are not limited to: Using Electronic Medical Records to record exams, materials, etc. Pre-testing patients Assisting patients with picking frames and providing spectacle lens packages/quotes Taking measurements to ensure lenses are made correctly Teaching new contact wearers how to insert and remove contact lenses Ordering and dispensing contact lenses and spectacles Adjusting frames Scheduling appointments Verifying vision insurance and submitting claims Tagging new inventory. Light cleaning Providing exceptional customer service Qualifications: Strong multi-tasking abilities Customer service oriented Ability to work independently and as part of a team ABO certification and optical experience not required, but is a plus Please note that this job description is not exhaustive and additional duties may be assigned as needed. Job Type: Full-time Employee discount Paid time off Schedule: Monday to Friday Supplemental Pay: Bonus opportunities Work Location: In person #LI-Promote

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:04429d73-.title: Principal Engineer - Security Logging & Detection
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:04429d73-.description: ABOUT US: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Principal Engineer, Security Logging & Detection, you will serve as the technical leader responsible for the engineering, reliability, and evolution of Gen's security logging and telemetry platforms. These foundational services power threat detection, security investigations, incident response, compliance, and security analytics across our global environment. In this highly collaborative role, you will work closely with Security Operations, Incident Response, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, and Product Engineering teams to design resilient, scalable, and secure telemetry solutions. You'll drive technical strategy, champion engineering excellence, and continuously improve the quality, availability, and operational effectiveness of security data across Gen. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Serve as the technical owner and architectural leader for Security Logging & Detection capabilities. - Design, build, and continuously improve logging pipelines and telemetry services across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. - Own the collection, parsing, normalization, enrichment, routing, retention, and access patterns for security telemetry. - Ensure the reliability, integrity, and availability of log data supporting threat detection, investigations, incident response, compliance, and security monitoring. - Drive automation and engineering best practices to improve scalability, consistency, operational efficiency, and platform reliability. - Identify opportunities to leverage AI-enabled technologies to improve security engineering workflows, telemetry analysis, and reporting. - Partner with Security Operations, Incident Response, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, and software engineering teams to improve telemetry coverage and detection capabilities. - Define technical standards, documentation, and operational processes that improve platform resilience, maintainability, and long-term sustainability. - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives and cross-functional teams. ABOUT YOU: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - Extensive experience in Security Engineering, Platform Engineering, Logging, Observability, Detection Engineering, or closely related disciplines. - Strong understanding of security logging architectures and telemetry pipelines, including data collection, transport, normalization, enrichment, storage, retention, and access patterns. - Experience building, operating, and scaling distributed systems or enterprise dat

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0d864b00-d689-.title: Social Media Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0d864b00-d689-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Manager based in France. This is a creative, hands-on opportunity for a social media professional passionate about photography, visual storytelling, and digital culture. You will own social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, helping shape the voice and presence of a globally recognized creative brand. The role combines strategic planning, content creation, performance analysis, and creator collaboration. You will experiment with new formats, trends, and storytelling approaches to discover what resonates with audiences at scale. Your work will directly influence brand awareness, community engagement, and the growth of social channels. You will join a collaborative and flexible environment where creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning are encouraged. This position is ideal for someone with strong visual instincts who enjoys taking ideas from concept through production, publication, and optimization. Develop and own the social media strategy, translating broader brand objectives into engaging, platform-specific content. Define channel strategies for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, including content pillars, editorial calendars, formats, and publishing plans. Identify emerging platform trends, content opportunities, and audience behaviors to keep the social strategy relevant and competitive. Plan, create, edit, and publish high-quality social content aligned with a premium visual identity. Produce short-form videos and other social-first creative assets designed to maximize engagement and audience growth. Continuously improve creative quality by testing new concepts, formats, hooks, storytelling techniques, and visual approaches. Establish performance metrics and reporting processes across social platforms. Monitor content performance, analyze audience behavior, and translate data into actionable recommendations. Run creative experiments and content tests to determine what drives the strongest engagement and growth. Collaborate with photographers, ambassadors, and creators to develop campaigns and compelling community-driven stories. Brief creators on campaigns and content requirements and help curate and repurpose user- and creator-generated content. Manage the social media workflow independently, from ideation and planning through production, publication, analysis, and optimization. Requirements At least 2 years of experience managing social media for a brand. Demonstrated experience growing Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube audiences organically. Strong portfolio showcasing high-performing social media content and creative work. Hands-on experience editing short-form video and producing social-first creative assets. Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of design, composition, and digital content principles. Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, audience behavior, and platform algorithms. Experience using analytics and performance data to evaluate and improve content strategies. Ability to combine creative thinking with a data-driven and experimentation-focused mindset. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects from initial concept through publication. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with creators and cross-functional stakeholders. A genuine interest in photography is a strong advantage, whether as a hobby or through professional experience. Familiarity with photo editing tools such as Luminar, Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar software is a plus. Benefits Remote working opportunity, with flexibility around how and where you work. Full-time employment in a creative and collaborative environment. Opportunity to contribute to award-winning photo editing products and a globally recognized visual brand. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:a7e6d069-b93e-45b.title: Founding Growth Development Rep - Spur
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:a7e6d069-b93e-45b.description: GROWTH DEVELOPMENT REP Meet Spur Spur has made a fundamental change in the testing piece. We help the world's largest brands like Aloyoga, NextDoor, LivingSpaces protect every checkout and every conversion with AI browser agents that simulate shoppers while navigating through the site. The company is backed by top tier VCs like FirstRound Capital, YCombinator, PearVC. THE TEAM Anuhska, and Sneha the co-founders have a combination of deep technical and product experience (deepmind and figma). Every person on the team punches much above our weight, we are all high leverage operators made up of ex-founders, customers and competitors.(what more could you want). We are a team of thoughtful and resourceful operators. We’re building AI agents that are changing the game for testing. Moving away from test scripts in code, to natural language based instructions that can tell the agent to just “checkout an item, and make sure the invoice is received in a confirmation email”. Days of work just automated in a single line. This is what we deliver to every customer. ROLE OVERVIEW: We’re looking for a Growth Development Rep (GDR) — part SDR, part field marketer, part content creator — to own top-of-funnel growth and bring Spur’s story to life. We have closed the biggest brands from inbound networks built on linkedin and through our customer referrals, and we;re looking for someone to join our sales team to drive up that top of the funnel and bring the company to the next stage of growth. You’ll generate pipeline through intelligent outbound, creative storytelling, and live event activation. You’ll be the first person many prospects meet — online and in person — and your energy will set the tone for how the world experiences Spur. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: A) Lead Generation & Outbound - Research and prioritize high-intent e-commerce and retail brands using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo, and 6sense. - Build multi-touch sequences across email, LinkedIn, and Slack Connect to book high-quality meetings. - Qualify leads through discovery calls and hand off to AEs with crisp context. - Track outreach and performance in HubSpot / Notion CRM. B) Event & Conference Activation - Partner with marketing on pre-event campaigns for conferences like ShopTalk and NRF. - Work our booth, give live demos, and engage attendees with authentic conversation (not scripts). - Coordinate pop-up dinners or “live test sessions” with the Spur team. - Follow up within 24 hours using personalized Looms and DMs. KEY IMPACT: - Be the engine behind Spur’s growth — turning outreach, content, and events into qualified pipeline. - Put Spur in front of every major e-commerce brand that should know us. - Directly impact revenue by fueling meetings, demos, and expansion conversations. 🧩 YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU… - Have 0-2 years of experience in SDR, growth, or creator-led marketing roles. - Are comfortable on camera and love storytelling. - Write clever, clear outreach messages and actually enjoy the hunt. - Thrive in fast-moving startup environments where you can experiment and own results. - Care about the future of AI, automation, and how technology shapes commerce.
